transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Since the V-12 vision-inspection station commissioning is scheduled for this weekend, I'd like to get our pre-work review started. Before I approve the work order, I need to check in with maintenance, quality, and safety. We also have an open question on placement — the station could go at either Cell 3 or Cell 7, both running the same product family. Does anyone have input on which cell would be the better fit, or any concerns from your area that we need to address before I make the final commissioning decision?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share what I found during my fit-up check. The V-12 camera mount aligns only with Cell 7's 6 mm bracket pattern — it won't fit Cell 3. Installing at Cell 7 requires exactly 4 hours and isolation of exactly 3 electrical points. I recorded all these measurements in the weekend commissioning file, but that file is still awaiting engineering signoff and hasn't been added to the work-order summary yet, so it may not be visible to everyone here.

The quality checklist has not yet been revised because the customer appendix is still being attached to the change record. So right now, if commissioning proceeds this weekend, we need to make sure those validation requirements are built into the plan — the current checklist won't reflect them yet.
